name: {speed}_LINE_MARKING_WHITE_YELLOW_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R4-SA100 1200 x 450 (1:10 sheet, 2016), square corners, no radius stated. Left half 450 x 450 white class 1 with the red annulus: outer R223, inner R178 (chain 2/223/225: 2 margin, centre x 225; 178 = inner radius), centre (225, 225); speed numerals 180 D centred (135/180/135). Right half 750 x 450: black border 20 round a yellow class 1 panel (x 450-1200): LINE 120 D baseline 195 (top 75), ink 325 (210/325/215 from the divide, centred on 825), MARKING 120 C baseline 375 (top 255), ink 565 (90/565/95). Sheet note: vehicle-mounted frames for mobile work sites only; only 25, 40 or 60 displayed -> generated at 25, 40, 60.
